stringUnit.value: Use the camera only when you choose to scan a QR code, take a photo for a play task, a city stamp, a post or your profile, or view an augmented-reality scene. Merchants also use it to photograph aftercare evidence. Nothing is captured in the background.
仅在你主动选择时使用相机：扫描二维码，为玩法任务、城市印章、动态或个人资料拍照，或查看 AR 场景；商家也会用它拍摄售后凭证照片。相机不会在后台拍摄。
